visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of three people sitting on a specialized agricultural transport vehicle within a dense orchard. A young woman in a pink floral sun hat is positioned centrally, her mouth wide open in an expressive 'wow' face, while a man to her right in a matching hat looks forward with a neutral expression. The background is filled with lush green foliage and fruit-bearing trees under bright natural daylight. (2) The scene cuts to a man wearing a black T-shirt, a white baseball cap, and dark sunglasses standing in front of a traditional Chinese temple entrance. He gestures with his hands in a rhythmic manner, as stylized text overlays such as 'Check it out man' and '一日龍眼乾製作' appear around him in a high-contrast graphic style. (3) Several people are seen actively harvesting fruit in the orchard. A woman in a blue shirt is reaching into the branches of a longan tree, picking bunches of small brown fruit. Another worker is seen climbing a metallic ladder leaned against a tree trunk to reach higher branches. The ground is covered in grass and fallen leaves. (4) In an industrial indoor setting, workers are pouring large yellow plastic crates full of longans onto a massive horizontal metal drying rack. The camera uses a top-down overhead perspective to show the fruit spreading across the mesh surface. The lighting is bright and industrial, highlighting the volume of the harvest. (5) The drying rack, now loaded with tons of fruit, is mechanically lifted upwards by a heavy-duty crane system. A woman in a red-and-white checkered dress and safety goggles watches the process alongside a man in a black T-shirt. The factory background is filled with metal pipes and industrial equipment. (6) A close-up shot shows a sorting machine in operation, where longans roll through rotating perforated metal cylinders. The fruit is then shown falling into large black baskets placed beneath the machine. A final shot shows a close-up of the shriveled, dark brown dried longan fruit laid out on a tray for inspection.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-pitched feminine vocal exclamation 'Wow!' overlapping with high-energy electronic pop music featuring a prominent four-on-the-floor beat. A metallic 'ding' SFX punctuates the transition. The vocal tone is extremely enthusiastic with high pitch variability. (2) A transition whoosh SFX occurs. The music shifts into a rhythmic hip-hop beat with a deep bassline. A male voice delivers the lines 'Check it out man, yo, what's up' with a cool, slightly exaggerated prosody. Ambient orchard sounds like rustling leaves are audible. (3) A sequence of percussive 'thudding' and 'shuffling' sounds occurs as longans are poured. The music maintains a fast tempo. Multiple voices engage in a rapid-fire Q&A session about harvesting, characterized by clear articulation and high emotional arousal. (4) A mechanical whirring sound combined with metallic clinking of chains triggers a shift in dialogue to the drying process. The background music level dips slightly to accommodate the speech, maintaining a consistent rhythm. The ambient texture is now an industrial room tone. (5) Fast rattling and clicking sounds of machinery dominate the mix as the speaker describes the sorting phase. The music swells in volume for the finale, ending with a bright, celebratory synthesized jingle and a calm, authoritative closing statement from the lead male voice.
